text:
Leah: Quick prelaunch sync — final checklist for webinar launch posts & benchmark narrative SEO. Need schema JSON-LD, internal links from blog hub to webinar landing, 301 redirects for old URLs, canonical checks, and CTA pathing. Who can own schema snippet and redirect map?

Sam: I can own JSON-LD + testing. Will add sample snippet.

Sam: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebPage",
  "headline": "Benchmark: LLM inference cost & latency playbook",
  "publisher": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},
  "isAccessibleForFree": true
}
```

Arjun: I'll run a redirect sweep from the KW list and map to landing. Need list of old slugs.

Maya: Adding canonical + hreflang checks to QA. Also can add internal link anchors from benchmark narrative to the 'cost savings' section.

Evan: Can someone confirm the webinar signup URL will persist? want stable /webinars/llm-inference-launch as canonical.

Leah: Yes @Evan using stable slug /webinars/llm-inference-launch. Please ensure 301 redirects from /webinar/* old ones. Arjun + Maya coordinate.

Sam: small note — structured data needs dates in ISO and proper author names. Also include event schema for live session if we push that.

seo-bot: Reminder: devsite-crawler scanned /blog and found 12 pages with missing canonical tags — see https://internal.crawl/scan/173999 (auto-report).

Arjun: grabbing KW list from the Figma doc -> posted in #marketing-resources. Will push redirect map by EOD, will include: old-slug-1 -> /webinars/llm-inference-launch, old-slug-2 -> /blog/benchmark-llm-economics.

Maya: QA checklist: canonical, meta descriptions, JSON-LD present, internal link to landing, noindex staging pages. I'll run prelaunch smoke and share results.

Leah: Also add internal links from these pillar posts: /blog/model-serving, /docs/optimize -> pointing to webinar landing. Use contextual anchors: 'cost per token' and 'autoscaling'.

Evan: ack. tagging @eng-ops in case we need fast redirect deploy.

eng-ops-bot: deploy request queued for redirects-config v3 — ETA 45m (ID: dq-173999)

Leah: Fallback plan: if redirect deploy delayed, put a banner on /blog saying 'Webinar moved — register here' linking to /events/llm-launch. :thumbsup:

Sam: Once JSON-LD and Event schema ready I'll run Rich Results test and paste screenshots.

Arjun: pushed redirect PR -> https://git.internal/redirects/pull/312, awaiting review from @Maya and @eng-ops.

Maya: reviewing PR now, found one edge case: query params on older campaign links. I'll add canonicalized rules.

Leah: Great. Please drop final signoff here when merged so marketing can greenlight the launch post. Thanks team! :rocket:
